purpose: OCID robot-camera +1 pairs: do the public pruners keep the object count that the full model reads, and does one added object move their answer by exactly one?

question.table: How many objects are on the table?
question.floor: How many objects are on the floor?

fixed_before_the_run.truth: number of object ids in the label mask; planes floor = {1}, table = {1, 2}; one sequence with ids + 255 normalised; pairs = consecutive frames with counts differing by one
fixed_before_the_run.scoring: phase1 count rule (common.is_correct); reference = F576 right on the frame; pairs = consecutive frames of one sequence and camera

primary.H1: at 64 tokens each of DivPrune, VisionZip and OC-VTP (seed mean) breaks >= 30 % of the frames F576 gets right (P[wrong | F576 right], lower bound of the 95 % CI above 0.30 counts as a clear pass; point estimate above 0.30 as a pass)
primary.H2: on reference-correct pairs, the share answered exactly +1 is lower at 64 tokens than for F576 for each method (paired difference, CI excludes 0)

secondary: under- vs over-count shares by true count
objects without a kept patch vs breaks (coverage diagnostic, DivPrune and OC-VTP kept sets)
no_tuning: no prompt, threshold or subset is chosen after seeing compressed answers; the k range reported is the one where F576 is right on >= 50 % of the frames, decided from F576 alone
